session.expiring: Your session will end soon due to inactivity.
company.baseCurrencyHint: Currency of entries and reports. Hard to change once transactions start.
company.baseCurrencyWarn: Changing the base currency will be blocked once financial transactions exist.
company.confirmCurrency: Change the base currency from {from} to {to}?
company.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 512KB. This is your company's logo for its documents; it is separate from the TAYL logo.
company.taylLogoNote: The official TAYL logo in the app is fixed and not affected by the company logo.
branch.name: Branch name
branch.codeHint: Latin letters and digits only (up to 20), unique per branch.
branch.confirmDisable: Disable branch {code}? No one can work in it until it's enabled again.
branch.scopeNote: Only the branches you're allowed to access are shown.
user.usernameHint: Latin letters, digits and . _ - (3 to 64); not case-sensitive.
user.passwordHint: At least 8 characters with a letter and a digit, and not containing the username.
user.initialPasswordHint: The user must change it at first sign-in.
user.superAdminHint: Full permissions on everything and all branches.
user.allBranchesHint: Access to all current and future branches.
user.selfNote: You can't change your own roles or branch scope; another admin must do it.
user.resetHint: The user's current sessions end and they must change it at sign-in.
role.intro: A role is a set of permissions. A user can have several roles and gets all their permissions. You can't grant a permission you don't have.
role.name: Role name
role.none: No roles yet. The super admin has every permission without a role.
precision.title: Calculation precision & rounding
precision.intro: Every calculation goes through one central decimal engine, without floating-point numbers. These rules apply to all modules; no module sets its own.
precision.level.storageDesc: Maximum decimal places stored per kind (fixed; values are stored as exact decimal text).
precision.level.intermediateDesc: {n} significant digits; addition, subtraction and multiplication are exact.
precision.level.commitDesc: Decimal places and rounding rule when an operation is committed — editable here.
precision.level.displayDesc: Decimal places shown on screens and reports only; doesn't change the stored value.
precision.changeNote: Changes apply to new operations only, never recalculate stored values, and are recorded in the audit log.
precision.preview: Try the policy on a value
precision.previewHint: A decimal number in Latin digits, e.g. 1234.56789
audit.intro: Append-only: no event can be edited or deleted. Passwords and session tokens are never recorded.
account.changeNote: Changing it signs you out on other devices.
account.mustChange: You must change your temporary password before using the app.

err.DECIMAL_NUMBER_NOT_ALLOWED: Send the decimal value as text.
val.NOT_IN_SCOPE: Must be an active branch within the user's branches.
val.PASSWORD_WEAK: Must contain at least one letter and one digit.
val.PASSWORD_UNCHANGED: The new password is the same as the current one.

err.DECIMAL_RATE_OUT_OF_RANGE: The rate must be between 0 and 100.
common.codeHint: Latin letters, digits and . _ -; saved in upper case.
common.name: Name
common.searchHint: Search by code, Arabic or English name… (Ctrl+F)
master.confirmDisable: Disable {code}? It won't be usable in new transactions.
master.confirmDelete: Delete {code} permanently? Only allowed if it isn't used anywhere.
keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.arrows: Move in results and tables; Right/Left expand or collapse the tree
keys.enter: Pick from a list, open a row, or go to the next field (never saves)
keys.ctrlNNote: Some browsers reserve Ctrl+N for a new window; Alt+N always works.
import.title: Import from Excel
import.intro: Choose an Excel file. Every row is checked and shown first; nothing is saved unless the whole file is valid.
account.intro: A group account only holds other accounts and takes no transactions; detail accounts are the ones future documents and entries use. No entries in this phase.
account.parentHint: Leave empty for a top-level account. The parent must be a group; the class is inherited.
account.classHint: Top-level accounts only; children inherit their parent's class.
account.isGroupHint: Takes no direct transactions; holds sub-accounts.
cc.intro: Cost centers form their own tree and can belong to a branch. Group or inactive centers can't be used in new transactions.
cc.branchHint: A child center follows its parent's branch.
treasury.intro: Defines cash boxes and bank accounts only; vouchers and reconciliation come later. Account number and IBAN are visible to authorized users only.
treasury.ibanHint: Optional; the check digits are verified.
treasury.sensitiveHidden: Hidden — you don't have access to bank details.
treasury.usableHint: Unticking keeps it active but blocks it from future transactions.
currency.intro: The base currency comes from company settings. A rate is the base-currency value of one unit. Rates are never edited or deleted; a mistake is fixed by a new entry with a reason, and the previous one stays in the history.
currency.codeHint: 3 letters per ISO 4217 (e.g. USD). Names fill in automatically for known currencies.
currency.decimalsHint: Decimals shown for amounts in this currency (doesn't change calculation precision).
currency.ratesIntro: Each rate has an effective date and a type. Documents keep the rate they used and are never recalculated with a newer one.
currency.rateHint: A positive decimal in Latin digits, up to 12 decimal places.
currency.reasonHint: Required. Saved with the new entry; the previous rate stays visible in the history.
currency.voidHint: Voids a rate entered with the wrong date or type. Nothing is deleted: new documents stop using it and it stays in the history.
fiscal.intro: Periods are generated automatically. Closing, reopening and final locking need separate permissions and a reason, and record who did it and when.
fiscal.addIntro: A year can start on any day (e.g. 1 July).
fiscal.reasonHint: Write a clear reason; it's kept in the log.
fiscal.lockWarning: Final lock can't be undone: the period can never be reopened.
fiscal.confirmDelete: Delete year {code} and its periods? Only allowed if all periods are open and unused.
pt.intro: Each term is a schedule whose percentages total exactly 100%. No collection or payment in this phase.
pt.percentHint: A percentage in Latin digits (e.g. 30 or 12.5).
pt.linesHint: Days from the document date, ascending; percentages total 100%.
pt.previewIntro: Enter an amount and a date to see the installments (calculated on the server; they total the amount exactly).
pm.intro: Payment methods for future vouchers and invoices.
pm.title: Payment methods
unit.intro: A general unit dictionary. Conversion factors (e.g. 1 carton = 4 boxes) are per item and are defined with items later.
err.PARENT_NOT_GROUP: The parent must be a group.
err.TREE_CYCLE: Can't move an item under itself or one of its children.
err.TREE_TOO_DEEP: Exceeds the maximum tree depth (15 levels).
err.IN_USE: It's used elsewhere; disable it instead of deleting.
err.CODE_LOCKED: A code that's in use can't be changed.
err.SENSITIVE_FORBIDDEN: You don't have access to sensitive bank details.
err.CLASS_MISMATCH: The account class must match its parent.
err.TYPE_CLASS_MISMATCH: The type belongs to another class.
err.ACCOUNT_NOT_ASSET: The cash/bank account must be an asset account.
err.BRANCH_MISMATCH: The branch must match the parent's branch.
err.BASE_CURRENCY_PROTECTED: The base currency is protected; manage it from company settings.
err.BASE_CURRENCY_RATE: The base currency rate is always 1.
err.RATE_EXISTS: A rate already exists for that currency, type and date; use Correct on the existing entry.
err.RATE_SUPERSEDED: This entry was already corrected; correct the current entry.
err.NO_RATE: No exchange rate is in effect on that date.
err.FISCAL_OVERLAP: The year overlaps another fiscal year.
err.FISCAL_YEAR_NOT_OPEN: A year with closed periods can't be deleted.
err.FISCAL_YEAR_HAS_HISTORY: The year has closing history; it can't be deleted.
err.PERIOD_STATUS: The period's status doesn't allow this.
err.NO_FISCAL_PERIOD: The date is outside the defined fiscal periods.
err.BAD_XLSX: The file isn't a valid Excel (.xlsx) file.
err.IMPORT_HAS_ERRORS: The file has errors; no row was saved.
val.CASH_NO_BANK_DATA: A cash box has no bank details.
val.END_BEFORE_START: The end date must be after the start.
val.YEAR_TOO_LONG: A fiscal year can't exceed 24 months.
err.DB_BUSY: The database is busy with another operation; nothing was saved. Please retry.
err.RATE_OVERRIDE_FORBIDDEN: A manual exchange rate requires the rate-override permission.
err.NOT_DRAFT: The entry is posted; it cannot be edited or deleted. Post a reversal.
err.ENTRY_TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED: This entry type is not available yet.
err.SERIES_LOCKED: Numbering series settings are locked after the first issued number.
err.SERIES_DEFAULT_REQUIRED: Make another series the default for this type first.
err.NO_SERIES: No valid numbering series for this document type.
err.NUMBER_CONFLICT: This document number text was already issued (usually after a branch code change); nothing was posted.
err.NO_BASE_CURRENCY: The base currency is not defined.
err.INVALID_AMOUNT: Invalid decimal value in a line.
err.TOO_PRECISE: More decimal places than the currency allows.
err.MANUAL_ENTRY_NOT_ALLOWED: This is a control account; it doesn't accept manual entries.
err.COST_CENTER_REQUIRED: A cost center is required for this account.
err.COST_CENTER_NOT_ALLOWED: This account doesn't accept a cost center.
err.COST_CENTER_BRANCH: The cost center belongs to another branch.
err.RATE_SOURCE_INVALID: The exchange rate source doesn't match the line currency.
err.RATE_NOT_CURRENT: The exchange rate is no longer current for the entry date; refresh the line.
err.LINE_SIDE: Each line is either a debit or a credit with a positive amount.
err.BASE_AMOUNT_ZERO: The line's base-currency amount is zero after conversion; merge it or change the amount.
err.FUTURE_DATE_NOT_CONFIRMED: The entry date is after today; explicit confirmation is required.
err.OPENING_DATE: Opening entries are dated on the first day of the first fiscal year only.
err.TOO_FEW_LINES: An entry needs at least two lines.
err.UNBALANCED: The entry isn't balanced: debits don't equal credits.
val.ONE_SIDE_REQUIRED: Enter a debit or a credit amount (only one).
journal.intro: Drafts are saved without a number and can be edited or deleted. Posting assigns a number and writes the entry to the general ledger permanently; a posted entry is corrected only by a reversal.
journal.openingIntro: Opening entries are dated on the first day of the first fiscal year, one effective entry per branch. Control accounts (customers, suppliers and inventory later) don't accept them, so their balances are never duplicated.
journal.editorIntro: Each line has its own currency and rate. Totals and base-currency amounts are calculated by the server as you type.
journal.searchHint: Search by number, description or reference…
journal.keysHint: Enter: next cell · Insert or Alt+L: new line · Ctrl+Delete: remove line · Ctrl+S: save
journal.confirmPost: Posting is final: the entry gets a number and is written to the general ledger and can't be edited afterwards. Continue?
journal.openingHint: The opening entry date is fixed: {date} (first day of the first fiscal year).
journal.reverseDateHint: Leave empty to use the original date if its period is open; otherwise pick a date in an open period (not before the original).
journal.reverseIntro: A posted reversal is created with every line on the opposite side at the same amounts and rates. The original entry doesn't change and can't be reversed again.
ledger.noData: No posted movements in this range.
ledger.journalIntro: Every posted document in the general ledger with its lines, in posting order.
ledger.statementIntro: Opening balance, then movements in date and posting order with a running balance. A group account includes all its detail accounts.
ledger.tbIntro: Opening balances, period movement and closing balances for each account; group accounts total their children. Click an account code to open its statement.
ledger.final: Final results: every period in range is locked.
ledger.reason.NO_FISCAL_PERIOD: The range isn't in a defined fiscal year
ledger.reason.PERIOD_OPEN: An open period is in range (figures may change)
ledger.reason.PERIOD_NOT_LOCKED: A closed but not locked period is in range
ledger.reason.PRIOR_YEAR_NOT_CLOSED: A prior year isn't closed for every branch (Year-end closing center): opening balances of revenue and expense accounts include prior years' results
ledger.yearEndedNotClosed: Fiscal year {year} ended on {end} and isn't closed; results after it aren't final until year-end closing is done.
series.intro: Numbers are issued only when posting and never reused. After the first number, identity, prefix, scope and length are locked; names, default and enabling stay editable.
series.prefixHint: Upper-case letters and digits, unique among series.
series.lockedHint: Numbers were issued from this series: code, type, prefix, scope and length are locked.
fiscal.reopenConfirm: This period has {n} posted entries. Reopening allows new entries to be posted on its dates. Continue?
fiscal.warn.EARLIER_PERIODS_OPEN: Closed — note that earlier periods are still open: {periods}
settings.journalSegregatePostingHint: When on, whoever created or last edited a draft can't post it.
err.FISCAL_YEAR_GAP: Fiscal years are contiguous: a new year starts the day after the last one ends.
err.FISCAL_YEAR_NOT_EDGE: Only the first or the last fiscal year can be deleted.
err.FISCAL_YEAR_BEFORE_FIRST: After the first posting, no year can be added before the first fiscal year.
err.PERIOD_LOCK_SEQUENCE: Lock the earlier periods first (final locking is sequential).
err.REOPEN_CONFIRM_REQUIRED: The period has posted entries; explicit confirmation is required to reopen it.
err.NOT_POSTED: Only a posted entry can be reversed.
err.REVERSAL_NOT_REVERSIBLE: A reversal can't be reversed; enter a new entry.
err.REVERSAL_DATE_REQUIRED: The original entry's period isn't open; choose a date in an open period.
err.OPENING_EXISTS: A posted opening entry exists for this branch; reverse it first to correct it.
err.SEGREGATION_REQUIRED: Segregation of duties is on: a different user must post this entry.
err.REPORT_TOO_LARGE: Too many movements for this report; narrow the period.
val.BEFORE_ORIGINAL: Can't be before the original entry date.
err.BRANCH_CODE_IN_NUMBERS: This code appears in another branch's document numbers; choose a new code.
val.USED_IN_NUMBERS: Used in another branch's document numbers.
err.FISCAL_YEAR_BEFORE_CLOSED: No year can be added before the first one once a period is closed or locked.
ledger.reason.RANGE_NOT_COVERED: Part of the range is outside the defined fiscal years (movements may be added later)
err.YEAR_CLOSED: The fiscal year is closed for this branch; no posting or drafts dated up to its end.
err.YEAR_NOT_CLOSED_FOR_LOCK: The last period of a year can be locked only after every branch with activity has closed the year.
err.PERIOD_LOCKED: The period is locked; nothing can be posted or reversed in it.
err.NOT_READY: There are blocking errors; nothing was done. Review the readiness check.
err.WARNINGS_NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED: There are warnings that must be acknowledged before executing.
err.PREVIEW_STALE: Data changed since the preview; preview again, then execute.
err.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: The request key was already used for another operation.
err.NO_BRANCHES: No required branches within your scope for this operation.
err.NOT_CLOSED: The year is not closed for this branch.
err.NOT_CARRIED: There is no active carry-forward for this year and branch.
err.NEXT_YEAR_CLOSED: The next year is closed for this branch; reopen it first (newest first).
err.NEXT_YEAR_HAS_ACTIVITY: The branch has activity in the next year; explicit confirmation is required.
err.CARRY_FORWARD_ACTIVE: Balances of this year are carried forward; revert the carry-forward too (permission required).
err.CLOSING_IN_PROGRESS: The result account cannot change while a year is closed for some branches only.
err.RE_ACCOUNT_INVALID: This account cannot be the year-result account.
err.RECONCILIATION_FAILED: Year-end balances did not reconcile with the carry-forward; nothing was saved.
err.CLOSING_FAILED: Income statement accounts were not zeroed; nothing was saved.
audit.action.year_end.closed: Fiscal year closed for a branch
audit.action.year_end.reopened: Fiscal year reopened for a branch
ye.intro: Closing is per year and branch: check readiness, preview, then execute with confirmation. Closing zeroes revenue and expenses into the result account; carry-forward moves balance-sheet balances to the first day of the next year. Everything goes through the same posting engine with document numbers.
ye.reportsIntro: Reports from the general ledger and posted closing documents; “not final” is shown with its reasons.
ye.reIntro: An active detail equity account that is not a control account and does not require a cost center. It cannot change while a year is closed for some branches only; each closing keeps its own snapshot.
ye.reLocked: Locked now: year {years} is partially closed.
ye.noLines: No lines (no balances); the operation is recorded without an entry.
ye.noPermission: You do not have permission to execute.
ye.confirmClose: Close year {year} for branches: {branches}. Revenue and expense accounts will be zeroed into the result account and no posting dated up to the year end will be allowed for these branches.
ye.confirmCloseCarry: Close year {year} and carry balance-sheet balances to the next year for branches: {branches}. Revenue and expenses will be zeroed and a carry-forward entry will be posted on the first day of the next year.
ye.confirmCarry: Carry balances of year {year} to the next year for branches: {branches}.
ye.confirmIrreversible: Nothing is deleted afterwards; correction is only by reopening (documented reversals).
ye.ackWarnings: I have read and acknowledge the warnings
ye.reopenWarning: Reopening reverses the closing entry with a numbered reversal and keeps the history. A year cannot be reopened while the next year is closed for this branch.
ye.revertCarryWarning: Reverting reverses the carry-forward entry with a numbered reversal; next-year balances stay correct because they are computed from the ledger.
ye.nextYearActivityConfirm: The branch has {n} document(s) in year {year}. Their balances remain correct, and balances must be carried forward again after the correction. Continue?
ye.report.carried: Balances carried to the next year
ye.closedOf: Closed for {n} of {total} branch(es) in scope
ye.allZeroAfter: All income statement accounts are zero after closing
ye.notZeroAfter: Income statement accounts are not zero (year not closed)
ye.residualMoved: Base residual moved to base currency
ye.issue.BRANCH_INACTIVE: Branch is inactive; activate it to close
ye.issue.YEAR_NOT_ENDED: The year has not ended yet
ye.issue.PREVIOUS_YEAR_NOT_CLOSED: The previous year is not closed for this branch
ye.issue.PREVIOUS_YEAR_NOT_CARRIED: Previous-year balances are not carried forward for this branch
ye.issue.PERIODS_INVALID: Year periods are missing or not contiguous
ye.issue.PERIODS_OPEN: Open periods in the year; close them first
ye.issue.LAST_PERIOD_LOCKED: The last period is locked; the closing entry cannot be posted
ye.issue.DRAFTS_EXIST: Draft entries dated up to the year end; post or delete them
ye.issue.LEDGER_INTEGRITY: The ledger integrity check found problems
ye.issue.BRANCH_UNBALANCED: Branch balances are not balanced in base currency
ye.issue.RE_ACCOUNT_NOT_SET: The year-result account is not set
ye.issue.RE_ACCOUNT_TYPE: The result account is not of type “Retained earnings”
ye.issue.RE_ACCOUNT_DIFFERS_IN_YEAR: Other branches closed this year into a different result account
ye.issue.BASE_CURRENCY_MISMATCH: A base-currency balance whose original and base amounts differ (corrupt data)
ye.issue.SPLIT_RATE_MISSING: No exchange rate at the year end to represent a foreign balance
ye.issue.UNREPRESENTABLE_BALANCE: A balance that cannot be represented as an entry line
ye.issue.NO_INCOME_STATEMENT_BALANCES: No revenue or expense balances; the closing is recorded without an entry
ye.issue.SPLIT_LINES: Foreign balances represented as a table-rate part plus a base residual
ye.issue.INACTIVE_ACCOUNTS_CLOSED: Inactive accounts with balances will be closed
ye.issue.NEXT_YEAR_MISSING: The next year is not defined; carry-forward needs it
ye.issue.NEXT_YEAR_NOT_INITIALIZED: The next year has no period on its first day
ye.issue.NEXT_YEAR_FIRST_PERIOD_LOCKED: The first period of the next year is locked
ye.issue.NEXT_YEAR_CLOSED: The next year is closed for this branch
ye.issue.BRANCH_NO_ACTIVITY: The branch has no activity up to the year end; closing without an entry
ye.issue.NOT_CLOSED: The year is not closed for this branch; close before carrying forward
ye.issue.INCOME_STATEMENT_NOT_ZERO: Income statement accounts are not zero
ye.issue.CARRY_FORWARD_UNBALANCED: The carry-forward entry is not balanced
ye.issue.NO_BALANCES_TO_CARRY: No balances to carry; the carry-forward is recorded without an entry
ye.issue.RESIDUAL_LINES: Base residuals carried in base currency
fs.unclosedResult: Result of periods not yet closed
fs.warn.UNEQUAL_PERIODS: Caution: the comparative period has a different number of days
fs.warn.COMPARATIVE_NOT_COVERED: Caution: the comparative period is not fully covered by defined fiscal years
fs.warn.OPENING_ENTRY_ON_INCOME_ACCOUNTS: Caution: an opening entry on income statement accounts in the period is not treated as a cash flow
fs.issue.UNCLASSIFIED_ACCOUNTS: Accounts with activity have no statement classification; the statement is incomplete and cannot be printed or exported
fs.issue.NO_CASH_ACCOUNTS: No account is classified as cash and equivalents
fs.intro: Statements from the general ledger: the income statement before closing entries, the financial position from cumulative balances with the result of unclosed periods, and cash flows by the indirect method. Carry-forward entries are never added. Each account opens its statement with the same scope.
fs.branchesHint: No selection = all permitted branches; Ctrl/Shift to select a group of branches.
fs.settingsIntro: Classification sets the income statement line for revenue and expense accounts and the cash flow activity for balance sheet accounts. It is set per account type and can be overridden per account. Cost of sales takes its line from its class. An unclassified account makes the statement incomplete.
err.STATEMENT_INCOMPLETE: The statement is not fully classified; it cannot be printed or exported.
err.STATEMENT_UNBALANCED: The statement is not balanced; it cannot be printed or exported.
err.STATEMENT_NOT_RECONCILED: The statement does not reconcile to the trial balance; it cannot be printed or exported.
err.COST_CENTER_NOT_SUPPORTED: Cost center analysis is available for the income statement only.
err.COMPARE_NEEDS_FULL_YEAR: Comparison with the previous year needs a full fiscal year.
err.BREAKDOWN_WITH_COMPARE: Column breakdown and comparison cannot be combined.
perm.special.inventory.allow_negative: Allow negative stock (with reason and audit)
perm.special.inventory.override_fefo: Override FEFO, quality and expiry (with reason and audit)
perm.special.inventory.maintenance: Inventory maintenance: verify and rebuild summaries
inv.help.opening: Opening stock per item, location and batch at cost. It posts a journal only if you choose an offset account; otherwise it is reconciled with the ledger opening entry.
inv.help.receipt: Adds stock at an approved cost: debit inventory, credit the counter account. Batch items need an existing or a new batch number.
inv.help.issue: Issues at the current weighted average: debit the issue account, credit inventory. Batch items follow FEFO automatically when no batch is chosen.
inv.help.transfer: Moves stock between two warehouses of the same branch at the same cost; no gain, no loss, no journal.
inv.help.transfer_out: Dispatch to a warehouse in another branch: the quantity is in transit and not available at the destination until received.
inv.help.adjust_in: A documented surplus, at the current item cost or a cost you enter, against the differences account.
inv.help.adjust_out: A documented shortage at the current average against the differences account.
inv.help.return: Return to stock: with an issue reference it takes the original issue cost exactly; without one, the current average.
inv.help.quality: Changes a batch quality status (available, inspection, rejected, hold, quarantine) without affecting quantity or value.
inv.col.withoutGl: Of which without a stock journal (opening)
inv.adjustmentAccountHint: Expense, COGS or revenue: receives count differences, adjustments and cost variances.
inv.asOfHint: Empty = current balances; a date = historical valuation from the movement log
inv.batchesIntro: Batches with production and expiry dates and quality status. Expired or unavailable batches are issued only with an authorised override and a reason.
inv.blindHint: The system quantity is hidden from counters until review
inv.blindNotice: Blind count: the system quantity is hidden until review.
inv.closeWarn: The remaining in-transit quantity is booked as a shortage to the differences account in the receiving branch and cannot be received afterwards.
inv.confirmCancel: Cancel the draft? No number is used.
inv.confirmPost: Post the document? It cannot be edited after posting; corrections are by reversal only.
inv.confirmPostCount: Post the count differences through adjustment documents?
inv.countGroupHint: Empty = all items in the warehouse
inv.countIntro: A snapshot of system quantities is taken at start; differences are measured against it even if movements happen afterwards.
inv.counterDefaultHint: Empty = the item, group or default account
inv.counterHint: For example: goods received not invoiced. No account is assumed.
inv.countsIntro: Count sessions: counting in rounds, review, approval, then posting differences through the central engine.
inv.documentsIntro: Every stock movement goes through a document: drafts have no effect, posting alone changes stock and the ledger, and corrections are by reversal.
inv.factorHint: How many base units are in one unit (decimals allowed, positive only)
inv.freezeHint: Blocks movements on the session items until posting or cancellation
inv.groupsIntro: Hierarchical groups; items sit on detail groups, and accounts and policies are inherited from the nearest group.
inv.inheritHint: Empty = inherited from the group, then the default
inv.inventoryAccountHint: An active detail asset account. No code is assumed.
inv.issueAccountHint: COGS, expense or asset (work in progress) that receives issue cost by default.
inv.itemsIntro: Codes are unique; an item with movements is deactivated, never deleted. Tracking policy and base unit are fixed after first use.
inv.methodNote: The valuation method is fixed per item; changing it for an item with movements needs a controlled historical conversion (not available in this release).
inv.openingOffsetHint: Empty = no journal (reconciled with the ledger opening entry, so no double balance)
inv.overridesNeeded: {n} line(s) need an authorised override with a reason
inv.policyHint: Fixed after the item is first used
inv.qualityWhHint: Reference warehouse for the document (the status applies to the batch in every warehouse)
inv.reportsIntro: All reports come from the movement log within your permissions; historical balances are built from movements up to the date.
inv.reservationsIntro: A reservation changes neither quantity nor value; available = on hand − reserved − unavailable.
inv.reserveIntro: You cannot reserve more than is available.
inv.reverseDateHint: Empty = today (in an open period, not before the item last movement)
inv.reverseWarn: Creates a full reversal linked to the original, reversing every quantity, cost and journal line. A document is reversed only once.
inv.searchBatches: Search by batch number or item code
inv.searchDocs: Search by number, reference or journal number
inv.settingsIntro: Accounts are chosen from the chart and checked for type and status. A movement that needs a journal is rejected if its settings are incomplete.
inv.transfersIntro: Branch transfers go through transit: stock is not available at the destination until received; partial receipts, rejects and documented closing are supported.
inv.transitAccountHint: An asset that holds branch transfers until they are received.
inv.unitsIntro: Base unit: {unit}. Each alternative unit = factor × base unit. Changing a factor does not change posted movements.
inv.unitsScreenIntro: Conversion factors are per item; the general unit dictionary is under reference data.
inv.valuesHidden: Values and costs hidden (requires the valuation view permission)
inv.warehousesIntro: Several warehouses per branch; quarantine warehouses are not available for issue. A warehouse with movements is deactivated, never deleted.
inv.whLockedHint: Branch and type are fixed after the first document
inv.whUsersIntro: A user added here is restricted to the warehouses they are added to (within their branches). Not added = all warehouses of their branches.
err.ACCOUNTING_SETTINGS_FORBIDDEN: Linking accounts requires the accounting settings permission
err.ACCOUNTING_SETTINGS_MISSING: Accounting settings are incomplete for this movement; set the account in settings, the group or the item
err.ACCOUNT_CLASS_NOT_ALLOWED: The account class does not fit this role
err.ACCOUNT_NOT_DETAIL: The account is a group; choose a detail account
err.ALREADY_COUNTED: The line is already counted; use recount
err.APPROVAL_REQUIRED: The document needs approval before posting
err.BACKDATED_MOVEMENT: Cannot post with a date earlier than the item last movement in this warehouse
err.BASE_UNIT_FACTOR: The base unit always has factor 1
err.BATCH_DATES_INVALID: Expiry date is before production date
err.BATCH_DATES_MISMATCH: The batch exists with different dates
err.BATCH_NOT_AVAILABLE: The batch is not available for issue (expired, quarantined, rejected or on hold); an authorised override with a reason is required
err.BATCH_REQUIRED: The item tracks batches: choose a batch
err.COST_INVARIANT: The movement would produce a negative or undefined quantity or cost
err.COST_REQUIRED: The item has no current cost; enter a unit cost
err.COUNT_IN_PROGRESS: A (frozen) count is open on this warehouse
err.COUNT_NOT_OPEN: The count is not in the counting stage
err.COUNT_STATE: The count status does not allow this action
err.DUPLICATE_COUNT_LINE: The item/location/batch is already in the session
err.EXPIRY_REQUIRED: An expiry date is required for this item
err.FUTURE_DATE: The document date is after today
err.INSUFFICIENT_STOCK: The requested quantity exceeds the balance
err.ITEM_NOT_BATCH_TRACKED: The item does not track batches
err.ITEM_NOT_SERIAL_TRACKED: The item does not track serial numbers
err.ITEM_NOT_STOCK: The item is non-stock and accepts no stock movements
err.ITEM_POLICY_LOCKED: The item policy is fixed after it was used
err.NEGATIVE_COST_UNKNOWN: There is no reliable cost for the item; negative stock is not allowed
err.NEGATIVE_DESTINATION: The destination balance is negative; adjust it first
err.NEGATIVE_FORBIDDEN: Negative stock requires a separate permission
err.OVERRIDE_FORBIDDEN: Overriding FEFO/quality requires a special permission
err.OVER_RESERVATION: Cannot reserve more than is available
err.QUALITY_CHANGED_SINCE: The batch status changed after this document; reverse the later one first
err.QUALITY_NO_CHANGE: The batch already has this status
err.RECEIPT_BEFORE_DISPATCH: The receipt date is before the dispatch date
err.RECEIPT_EXCEEDS_TRANSIT: The quantity exceeds what remains in transit
err.REJECT_WAREHOUSE: Rejects go to a quarantine warehouse in the receiving branch
err.RESERVED_STOCK: The quantity exceeds the unreserved available stock
err.RETURN_EXCEEDS_ISSUE: The return exceeds what remains of the original issue
err.REVERSAL_COST_CONFLICT: The reversal would leave a negative cost or value without quantity; reverse later movements first
err.REVERSAL_DATE: The reversal date cannot precede the original document date
err.SAME_WAREHOUSE: Cannot transfer to the same warehouse
err.SERIALS_REQUIRED: The number of serial numbers must equal the quantity
err.SERIAL_IN_STOCK: The serial number is already in stock
err.SERIAL_NOT_IN_STOCK: The serial number is not in this warehouse
err.SOURCE_LOCKED: The document is managed from its source
err.TRANSFER_BRANCH: The transfer type does not fit the two warehouse branches
err.TRANSFER_HAS_RECEIPTS: The transfer has receipts or settlements; reverse them first
err.TRANSFER_NOT_OPEN: The transfer is not in transit
err.UNCOUNTED_LINES: Some lines are not counted yet
err.UNIT_NOT_DEFINED: The unit is not defined for this item
err.WAREHOUSE_LOCKED: Warehouse branch and type are fixed after the first document
err.FEFO_VIOLATION: FEFO violation: an earlier-expiring batch is available; an authorised override with a reason is required
err.WAREHOUSE_INACTIVE: The warehouse is inactive; no movements allowed
val.BELOW_MIN: Below the minimum or reorder level
val.NON_STOCK_NO_TRACKING: A non-stock item cannot be tracked
val.NOT_FOR_ITEM: Does not belong to this item
val.NOT_FOR_LINE: Does not belong to this line
val.NOT_WITH_BATCHES: Cannot be combined with batch tracking
